text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting.
choice_data_list:
I haven't been waiting at all, so don't 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm glad to hear it. Now, let's take 
our time and enjoy today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Our hot spring trip.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'm soooooo excited...! How long has it 
been since I last felt like this?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Today, I'm gonna play hard and relax as 
much as I can with Trainer...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Let the ultimate hot spring trip begin!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
This atmosphere is wonderful. It feels 
like the quintessential hot spring town.
choice_data_list:
Shall we drop our bags at the inn and then 
explore?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right. Let's go around and try the local 
street food.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Your room has a lovely view too, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: How did things go on your end, Luck?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My hometown is lovely too. The mountain 
scenery is gorgeous. You should definitely 
come visit sometime.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's see~ I personally liked the matcha 
manju, but what about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Ah, I think matcha was my favorite too.

Ah, matcha might have been my favorite 
too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What a coincidence. Shall we put 
this on our list of souvenir candidates, 
then?
choice_data_list:
Sounds good. Should we put one in the 
Trainer's office too?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's an excellent idea. Let's definitely 
do that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (――...This is fun.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even the most trivial little things feel 
genuinely fun today――)
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(After this, I'll have dinner... relax for 
a bit, go back to my room and sleep...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And tomorrow, we head back to the 
academy...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow... it went by in a flash...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...And it was so much fun, too...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The meal was delicious, wasn't it? It was 
so extravagant right to the very end.
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, I'm completely full!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you looked like you were really 
enjoying it. Going, "It's a treasure box 
of flavor~!" and all.
choice_data_list: My gourmet hunter blood is stirring...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, when on earth did you start a job like 
that?
choice_data_list: Since about 30 minutes ago.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You're a total newbie, ain't ya?! You 
ain't got the bloodline or nothin' yet!!
choice_data_list:
Right, my main job is being a Trainer, and 
luck comes first.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look who's got a clever comeback 
again! Enough already!
choice_data_list: Haha.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list:
Well, maybe I'll head back to my room 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes, that's right. Is it that time 
already...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Good night.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you get some good rest too, Luck!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(—Uh-oh. I grabbed Trainer's sleeve 
without thinking.)
choice_data_list: Luck?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer............ 
Um............ with me...—
choice_data_list: ...Got it, Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list:
So you want to eat a matcha manju too, 
Luck.

So you want to eat a matcha manju too, 
Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Pardon?
choice_data_list: There's always room for sweets!
There's always room for sweets, right!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Heh... heheh...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right...! I wanna eat some 
manju too...!
choice_data_list:
Then I'll brew some tea and let's relax a 
little longer!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Honestly, you're always like this.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Ah, today's really been so much fun.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm really... so lucky.)

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Lucky Lilac...
